notes.video: Head-camera clips (640x480, H.264, 30 fps, no audio). Each clip is condensed from the replay video: speed varies per segment (see segments), and cuts between non-contiguous segments are 0.4 s cross-dissolves.
notes.times: All event/memory times are seconds in the condensed clip. Zero-length events (t0 == t1) mark instantaneous moments: questions (qa), spoken answers or remarks (speech), or a skill call that ended without motion.
notes.memory: Memory frames are the stored 640x480 head-camera frames (downscaled to 480x360). boxes.bbox_norm are the benchmark detections for that frame, normalized [x0, y0, x1, y1]; the integer id is the object identifier the agent sees. text_record lists the matching entries of the text-only observation for the same step.
notes.tour: Every experience phase starts with the scene’s shared scripted tour, which is not part of these clips.
